decision: dispatched SmartCloser deletion to a subagent rather than doing it in the main thread

decision: wrote the migration as an importable module with a thin CLI guard instead of a plain script
why: a script whose logic only runs via the command line cannot be tested; exporting migrate() lets a real test drive it against a fixture

decision: made the migration converge rather than assume a clean start
why: it runs against a live production database where a crash halfway is normal; every step checks whether it already applied
result: second run reports alreadyMigrated instead of erroring on a dropped column

decision: snapshot via VACUUM INTO rather than copying the file
why: the database has a hot WAL, so a file copy would silently miss uncheckpointed writes
result: snapshot verified readable and non-empty before any drop

decision: proved the lever with a test against a fixture built from the exact production schema
why: the alternative was running it on production and hoping; a committed test is something a reviewer can rerun

decision: kept the verification script database-only instead of adding a UI driver

decision: wrote a post-migration checker that asserts survival as well as removal
